title: Shrinking a single local etale representative across a closed immersion
statement: Let i:Z→X be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], F a sheaf of sets on X_et, and t a section of i_et^*F at the base change of the identity X-object [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. Let W be an etale Z-object, U an etale X-object, a:W→U times_X Z a morphism over Z, and s in F(U). Suppose t restricted along the unique terminal-object map from W equals i^*s restricted along a. Then there exist an etale X-object U_prime and a section s_prime in F(U_prime) such that the image of W→Z→X lies in the image of U_prime→X and i^*s_prime equals t restricted to U_prime times_X Z. Neither a covering condition on W nor compactness nor Zariski-unit injectivity is assumed.

proof.text: The projection U times_X Z→U is a closed immersion. By its inducing topology O is the inverse image of an ambient open U_prime of U. Restrict the structure map and s to that open. Factor a through U_prime times_X Z using the pullback universal property and the open-immersion lifting property. By construction the factor is surjective.

proof.text: The factor is a singleton etale cover. Naturality of the unit makes the restricted equality precisely the desired equation after this cover. Sheaf separatedness gives equality on the whole base change. The image of W lies in U_prime by its factorization. If W is empty take the empty ambient open and use the empty-cover sheaf axiom.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_closed_section_shrink
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))))
    (W : Z.Etale) (U : X.Etale)
    (a : W ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj U)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op U))
    (ht : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
        (((MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale X).isTerminalObj
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).from W).op
        t = ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map a.op
          (etaleSetDescentUnit i F U s)) :
    ∃ (U' : X.Etale) (s' : F.obj.obj (op U')),
      Set.range (W.hom ≫ i) ⊆ Set.range U'.hom ∧
      etaleSetDescentUnit i F U' s' =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk U'.hom (Category.comp_id _) :
              U' ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t
